svg.aria-label: A cross-section of rock strata, oldest at the bottom. Shell functions and aliases. Config instead of credentials in Slack. MCP integrations for Jira, GitLab, Grafana and Slack. Steering files that explain the codebase. Hooks that block bad patterns. On top, the ticket to PR workflow. Each layer is labelled with the thing I got tired of.
svg.text: no grand plan. just layers of small refusals
tired of doing each step by hand
tired of catching bad patterns in review
tired of typing the same thing
oldest at the bottom. every layer started as "I'm not doing this again."
